description: LEX FORENSICA v8.0 — Firestore Collection Schemas. All encryptedData fields contain AES-256-GCM ciphertext (Base64). iv and salt are Base64-encoded Uint8Array values used for PBKDF2 key derivation and AES-GCM decryption.

audits.description: Stores fully encrypted AuditResponse documents. One document per audit run.

id.description: UUID v4 document identifier, matches the Firestore document ID

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user. Used for Firestore security rule enforcement.

encryptedData.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (Base64) of the full AuditResponse JSON payload

iv.description: Base64-encoded 12-byte AES-GCM initialisation vector, unique per write

salt.description: Base64-encoded 16-byte PBKDF2 salt, unique per write

createdAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) when the document was first created

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) of the most recent write

audit_metadata.description: Stores encrypted metadata summaries for each audit. Resolves BLOCKER-02a. Document ID equals the corresponding auditId from the 'audits' collection.
audit_metadata.documentIdStrategy: auditId (mirrors the audits collection document ID)

id.description: Audit ID — mirrors the document ID of the parent audit in the 'audits' collection

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

encryptedData.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (Base64) of a JSON object with shape: { keyFlags: string[]; summary: string; riskLevel: string }

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) of the most recent write

keyFlags.description: List of high-level flag codes raised during the audit

chat_histories.description: Stores encrypted chat message threads associated with a specific audit. Resolves BLOCKER-02b. Document ID equals the associated auditId.
chat_histories.documentIdStrategy: auditId (one chat history document per audit)

id.description: Audit ID — mirrors the document ID of the parent audit

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

auditId.description: Explicit reference to the parent audit document ID in the 'audits' collection

encryptedData.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (Base64) of a JSON array of ChatMessage objects

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) of the most recent write

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the message was sent

skss_registry.description: Stores encrypted SKSS (Semantic Knowledge & Specialised Semantics) terminology entries. Implements CoC 0x05. Document ID equals SKSSEntry.id.

id.description: UUID of the SKSS entry, mirrors SKSSEntry.id

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user

encryptedData.description: AES-256-GCM ciphertext (Base64) of the full SKSSEntry JSON object

updatedAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) of the most recent write

id.description: UUID v4 identifier for the entry

domain.description: Knowledge domain the term belongs to (e.g. psychiatric, legal, pharmacological)

biasIndicator.description: Whether the term is flagged as carrying institutional bias

phoneticallyAmbiguous.description: Whether the term is phonetically ambiguous across languages

createdAt.description: Unix epoch timestamp (ms) when the entry was created
